CardDescription.DefaultText:
Found in pine areas. Needs high acidity, mid hydration and low nutrients. Grows faster during autumn.

Psychoactive mushroom. Causes gastrointestinal irritation if consumed raw.
CardDescription.Text: 生长在松林地区。需要高酸度、中等湿度和低等养分。秋天长得更快。\n\n致幻蘑菇，若生吃会刺激到肠胃。
CardDescription.zh: 生长在松林地区。需要高酸度、中等湿度和低等养分。秋天长得更快。\n\n致幻蘑菇，若生吃会刺激到肠胃。
CardDescription.en: Found in pine areas. Needs high acidity, mid hydration and low nutrients. Grows faster during autumn.\n\nPsychoactive mushroom. Causes gastrointestinal irritation if consumed raw.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Found: Pine areas. Growth Needs: High Acidity, Mid Hydration, Low Nutrients and presence of Pine Trees. Benefits: Psychoactive, Gastrointestinal Irritant.
